name: Maya Gurung
role: Head Coach · Former National Amateur Finalist
bio: Maya has run the floor at Iron Bell since 2016. She fought as an amateur for eight years before turning to full-time coaching, and still spars twice a week to keep her eye sharp. Her focus is footwork and defense first, power later.
quote: Footwork first. If your feet are wrong, nothing after that matters.

name: Sujan Rai
bio: Sujan built the conditioning program at Iron Bell from scratch, drawing on his background as a track athlete. He believes most fights are lost to fatigue long before they're lost to skill.
quote: You don't get tired in the ring. You get tired here, so the ring feels easy.

name: Dev Thapa
bio: Dev runs the 21-day Fundamentals program and the Saturday-adjacent youth classes. He's trained more first-time boxers than anyone on staff and has a reputation for patience.
quote: Everyone in this gym was a beginner. Some of them just showed up more.
